status: frozen before fold-two preparation and scoring
data_identity: existing audited hourly zonal count snapshot divided by matching filtered capacity; not arbitrary upstream percentage files
exposure: new to these candidates, not certified globally unexposed; previous fold test timestamps enter expanding training; no fold-two test scoring or loading

region.affinity: absolute zero-lag Pearson on last 288 training hours; original greedy balanced partition

duration.groups: same occupancy-derived K32 partition; augmented tasks have up to 64 channels, occupancy first
duration.duration_permutation: fixed global derangement of zone columns from seed 44; no target-based selection

ridge.features: 168 centered occupancy history plus optional 168 lagged raw duration or duplicate centered occupancy; train-only standardization

metric: clipped RMSE primary and MAE co-primary safeguard; raw metrics retained; equal mean of H3 and H12 cell scores

gate.region_reference: best macro-RMSE among full and each random seed; report all
gate.duration_reference: best macro-RMSE among occupancy and duplicate-occupancy within each backbone
gate.negative_control: duration must also beat fixed permuted-duration in macro RMSE and not worsen MAE
gate.joint_duration_replicates: both ridge and frozen Chronos gates pass; otherwise classify backbone-specific or NO_GO

uncertainty: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over origins, block24, 2000 repeats, seed20260910; all zones and steps retained together; within-window descriptive intervals only
privacy: publish summaries and hashes, not targets, input arrays, model weights or zone partitions
